extraction.Name: Jennie Wright
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded May 20, 1921 by Carter State Bank
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612745 issued; Northwest quarter, section 13, township 97, N. R. 79; receipt signed by allottee February 5, 1918; deed dated August 10, 1922, signed by Jennie and James Wright, conveyed the N/2 of Section 13, township 97, north of range 79 to William M. Knude for $7000.00 (this would include the Northwest quarter of section 13); document stamped Rosebud, S.D., JUN 1929
